examName: Assistant Commissioner (Divisional Officer), Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation
examPattern: Written Examination (200 marks) followed by Interview (50 marks)

papers.paperTitle: Administration and Management, Personnel & Financial Management, Project Planning & Appraisal, Disaster Management, Urban Development, Basic Principles of Law & Judiciary
papers.paperTitleMr: प्रशासन आणि व्यवस्थापन, कार्मिक आणि वित्तीय व्यवस्थापन, प्रकल्प नियोजन आणि मूल्यमापन, आपत्ती व्यवस्थापन, शहरी विकास, कायदा आणि न्यायव्यवस्था यांची मूलभूत तत्त्वे

topics: organizational structures with special reference to Municipal Corporations
Areas of interface between the Government & the Municipal Corporations
key concepts of Management-planning, organizing, authority, delegation, control, Human Relations
Budget, Budgetary process with special reference to Municipal Corporations
CPM & PERT operating requirement & cost viability of the project
Different authorities in planning and appraisal for Mumbai Metropolitan Area
Vulnerability of Mumbai to Natural & Manmade disaster
History and case study of disasters in Mumbai in last 25 years
Methods of disaster mitigation in context of Mumbai
Management of resources for urban life
specific problems of Mumbai & their remedies
Acts and Rules relating to them, SRA schemes
sound pollution and related case studies & court cases
Encroachments on roads and footpaths and actions taken by BMC
FSI, CRZ, Illegal construction and regularisable construction

importantNotes: नकारात्मक गुणदान - प्रत्येक चुकीच्या उत्तराकरिता २५% किंवा १/४ एवढे गुण एकूण गुणांमधून वजा/कमी करण्यात येतील.
अिमम गुणवत्ता यादी ही वस्तुनिष्ठ परीक्षेतील व मुलाखतीतील एकत्रित गुणांवर आधारित राहील.
